basics.heading: Basics
basics.body:
Type math on the left; results appear live on the right, one per line.

- `,` and `.` are both the decimal point: `3,5 + 1,5` = `5`.
- Word operators in English and German: `times`/`mal`, `plus`, `minus`, `divided by`/`durch`, `to the power of`/`hoch`, `modulo`/`mod`.
- Symbols: `+ - * / ^ %`. `^` is power. Parentheses and unary minus work as expected.
- Percent: `100 + 19%` = `119`; phrases include `20% of 50`, `5% on 30`, `6% off 40`, and German `20% von 50`.
- Radix numbers: enter `0xFF`, `0b1010`, or `0o17`; use `255 in hex`, `10 in bin`, or `15 in oct` for output.
- Mass units include `g`, `kg`, `lb`, and `oz`; convert with `in` or `to`.
- Functions & constants: `sqrt`, `min`, `max`, trig, logs, `pi`, `e`. Multi-arg functions use `;`: `min(3;9;1)`.
- Grow/shrink the font with `Ctrl++` / `Ctrl+-`.

commands.heading: Commands
commands.body:
Type a `/`-command anywhere in a line and press Enter; it acts on the editor and produces no result.

- `/clear` — clear the whole document.
- `/copy` — copy every line as `input = result`.
- `/copy-last` — copy the last result.
- `/paste-last-result` — insert the last result at the cursor.
- `/help` — open this help window.
- `/release-notes` — open the release notes.
- `/exit` — quit the app.
- `/round <n|off>` — cap results at `n` decimals (rounds, never pads); `off` restores full precision. Persists.
- `/currency-rates <on|off>` — enable or disable daily currency rates; no argument toggles. Euro works without rates.
- `/window-…` — appearance: `/window-theme`, `/window-opacity`, `/window-margin`, `/window-title`, `/window-highlighting`, and the `/window-*-color` commands. All persist across restarts.

As you type, a ghost shows the shared prefix; press Tab to complete.

variables.heading: Variables
variables.body:
Assign once and reuse below:

```
price = 20
price minus 5 mal 2   -> 10
```

Inline variables: `$sum` totals the current group, `$prev` gives the nearest earlier result (even across blank lines), and `$avg` averages values in the current group.

```
10
20
$avg       -> 15
$prev + 5  -> 20
```

Type `$` to autocomplete. Currency amounts use suffixes such as `20 usd` or `50 €`; rates are off by default. Use `/currency-rates on` to fetch daily ECB rates, cached for offline use. See Currency in the project documentation for details.

running.heading: Running (pace, time, distance)
running.body:
Distances and times carry their units, so pace, finish time and speed just work.

- Distances: `km`, `mi`, `m`. Times: type `mm:ss` or `h:mm:ss` (`50:00`, `1:23:45`), or `min`/`h`/`s` (`30 min`).
- Pace = time ÷ distance: `50:00 / 10 km` -> `5:00 /km`.
- Finish time = pace × distance: `4:30 min/km * 42.195 km` -> `3:09:53`.
- Speed = distance ÷ time: `10 km / 50:00` -> `12 km/h`.
- Convert with `in`/`to`: `10 km in mi`, `5:00 /km in min/mi`, `12 km/h in mph`.
- Add compatible units: `5 mi + 3 km` -> `11.05 km`. Note `km mi m min h s` are reserved names.
